feeds.title: LGBTQ Reads
feeds.description: LGBTQ Reads is a site dedicated to promoting curated LGBTQIAP+ literature for all ages, run by author and blogger Dahlia Adler.

feeds.title: Lee Wind Blog
feeds.description: Covers different genres of LGBTQ books for kids and teens. Lee Wind's superpower is to share stories that center marginalized kids and teens and celebrate their power to change the world.

feeds.title: The Lesbian Review
feeds.description: The Lesbian Review is a site dedicated to bringing you only the best lesbian books, audiobooks movies, and music.

feeds.title: The Lesbrary
feeds.description: The Lesbrary is a book blog about bi and lesbian books, mostly made up of book reviews, but also features a collection of all the latest lesbian and bi-lit news and guest posts. You can browse by Genre, Category, or representation.

feeds.title: The Queer Bookish
feeds.description: The blog features books on queer literature, gender diversity, orientation, and more. Daniela rambles about queer books she loves and vents about bookish topics she is bothered by.

feeds.title: The Gay & Lesbian Review » Books
feeds.description: Features book reviews on LGBT based books. The Mission of The Gay & Lesbian Review is to advance gay and lesbian culture by providing a quality vehicle for its best writers and thinkers and to educate a broader public on gay and lesbian topics.

feeds.title: Autostraddle » LGBT Book Reviews
feeds.description: This section of the blog covers posts on LGBT Book Reviews. Autostraddle is a digital publication and real life community for multiple generations of LGBTQIA+ humans.

feeds.title: Out in Print: Queer Book Reviews
feeds.description: Jerry L. Wheeler has published numerous short stories, interviews, articles, and essays. He is the editor of the Lambda Literary Award finalist Tented: Gay Erotic Tales from Under the Big Top (Lethe Press, 2010) as well as the author of another Lambda Literary Award finalist, Strawberries and Other Erotic Fruits (Lethe Press, 2012).

feeds.title: That's What I'm Talking About » LGBTQ
feeds.description: I founded That's What I'm Talking About on January 28, 2010, as a place to discuss in better detail the books we were chatting about on Twitter. My blog is a project of love, and I'm so glad to share it with you. Here I'll be sharing my love of LGBTQ books. Read articles and reviews to add the best books to your TBR.

feeds.title: Malinda Lo Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to a curated selection of blog posts by Malinda Lo, covering topics such as writing, diversity, LGBTQ+ young adult literature, and her own books, with entries dating back to 2008. Malinda Lo is a New York Times bestselling author of seven novels, most recently A Scatter of Light. Her work has earned 15 starred reviews and been named finalists for numerous awards, including the Andre Norton Award and the Lambda Literary Award. She has also been honored by the Carnegie Corporation as a Great Immigrant.

feeds.title: She Reads Romance Books » LGBTQ Romance
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Leslie I'm a self-professed romance book lover who likes her books hot and her book boyfriends even hotter. In this section, you find all the LGBTQ books I have read and reviewed for you. My romance book favorites fall into the contemporary romance, erotic romance, and historical romance categories with some of my favorite tropes being enemies to lovers, office romance, sports romance, and more.

feeds.title: Jae Author Blog
feeds.description: This is the blog of Jae, an award-winning author of lesbian fiction. Blog posts about new and upcoming releases, writing tips, and book reviews exist. Jae is the author of twenty-three award-winning lesbian romances. When she's not writing, she is an avid reader of lesbian books, indulges her ice cream and stationery addictions, and watches way too many crime shows.

feeds.title: Love Bytes Reviews - LGBTQ Romance Book Reviews
feeds.description: Love Bytes Reviews has difficulty providing books for LGBT people. Explore their blog to find out how they are promoting the well-deserved recognition of their works through reviews, giveaways for the writers, showcasing their most recent publications, blog tours, author interviews, and much more.

feeds.title: Gay Book Promotions
feeds.description: This is an online service for authors of LGBT+ romance and fiction. Whether your story features gay, lesbian, bi, ace, trans, or questioning characters; whether there are couples, menage, polyamorous, or taboo relationships within the romance genre, I hope you will choose one of our services to help promote your book.

feeds.title: Joyfully Jay
feeds.description: Welcome to Joyfully Jay! My name is Jay and I started this blog because I love to read and wanted a place to share my thoughts with other readers and lovers of romance. As my family will tell you, I have an opinion on everything and I love to talk about books, so a blog seemed like a fun outlet!

feeds.title: LitBuzz » LGBTQ
feeds.description: LitBuzz is a fun venture by a bunch of bibliophiles who love discovering new and fun authors and sharing them with the world. We have a diverse interest base, so the variety of books you find here will always be exciting and we will always be looking for more! What started out as a little hobby site has grown to encompass over a dozen talented writers (Bees) from around the country and around the corner. Check out various LGBTQ genre books, reviews, new books and more!

feeds.title: Book Riot » LGBTQ
feeds.description: BookRiot.com is the largest independent literary site in North America, brings you news, bookish commentary, and recs for readers of all stripes. Read our articles on LGBTQ, recommendations, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Proud Geek Blog
feeds.description: Queer book recommendations, LGBT film and TV, gay podcasts and free trans webcomics. Discover the best wlw books coming this year or your new favourite podcast here. Proud Geek is a specialist retailer of LGBT+ entertainment and media, offering a wide range of titles from the past 25 years. Proud Geek aims to be your one-stop-online-shop for everything geeky and queer: from sapphic fiction, to trans superheroes, to gay teen coming of age classics, we have you covered.

feeds.title: Queer and Loathing in America
feeds.description: GREG HERREN has written and published over thirty novels and over fifty short stories, under his own name and various others. He has also edited over twenty anthologies. He has won two Lambda Literary Awards and an Anthony Award. Check out his book reviews and recommendations on Queer books here.

feeds.title: Mombian
feeds.description: Mombian is a lifestyle site for lesbian moms and other LGBTQ parents, offering a mix of parenting, politics, diversions, and resources. Dana Rudolph founded Mombian in 2005 after noting a lack of sites with current, practical news and information for LGBTQ parents, or sites that looked at other aspects of LGBTQ culture with a parent's eye. She hopes lesbian moms (and others) will find something interesting and perhaps worthy of conversation.

feeds.title: KBbookreviews
feeds.description: I'm Kat. I am a 20-something UK book lover who cannot remember a time when books were not the love of her life. My favourite genre has always been fantasy but I also love to read anything and everything. I am a physically disabled queer woman, a wheelchair user, which is partly why I love to see inclusivity in books that I read. I am a UK reviewer who mainly reviews books from Netgalley, and also will do so for publishers or authors, but will occasionally review books I own or have been gifted/bought myself.

feeds.title: The Turnaround Blog » Queer Fiction
feeds.description: Explore posts about Queer Fiction written by Julia, Em, Khadija, Liam, Ben, and Turnaround. Turnaround has been distributing books in the UK and overseas since 1984, and as you can imagine, everyone who works here is a veritable book-nut. Hundreds of books pass through our hands each month in every genre you can think of (and some you probably can't).

feeds.title: elementarymydear
feeds.description: My name is Lizzie. I'm 26, I live in South Wales, and I'm a professional musician. I'm an intersectional feminist, bisexual, and I use she/her pronouns. You'll find all sorts of books on here. I read a range of genres, including fantasy, non-fiction, historical fiction, literary fiction and queer books.

feeds.title: Enthralled Bookworm
feeds.description: Enthralled Bookworm blog is a collection of Alexandra Nae's detailed reviews, she'll also be posting blogs/listicles, interviews, unboxings, and just altogether bookish things. You can also expect occasional personal blogs or music-related blogs here.

feeds.title: Philly AIDS Thrift @ Giovanni's Room
feeds.description: We pride ourselves on being a unique and friendly neighbourhood store that has something for everyone! While we continue to be your #1 source for new and lightly used LGBTQ fiction & non-fiction, we have expanded our selection to include: music, artwork, comics, Grussvom Krampus, Clothing, and Much Much More!

feeds.title: BookMenDC
feeds.description: BookMen DC is an informal group of men who are interested in gay literature (both fiction and non-fiction). The group gets together on the first and third Wednesdays of each month for meetings lasting about an hour. Explore our reviews on various books here.

feeds.title: Jim Provenzano - Author
feeds.description: Author of the novels Finding Tulsa,Now I'm Here, PINS, Monkey Suits, Cyclizen, the stage adaptation of PINS the audiobook of PINS, the Lambda Literary Award winner Every Time I Think of You its Lammy Finalist sequel Message of Love, and the short fiction collection Forty Wild Crushes. Stay up to date with Jim's newest books, stories, news and more!

feeds.title: The Book Lover's Boudoir » LGBT Fiction
feeds.description: I'm Pamela. I love books, write fiction and poetry. This site will review books I have been given by publishers, authors or have obtained via NetGalley etc. Check out the best of LGBT books, and their reviews here.

feeds.title: Sheaf & Ink » LGBTQ
feeds.description: I read books and write reviews. I raise children, three to be exact, and sometimes I go for long walks or run on a treadmill. I also bake pies. Read along as I review all the LGBT books I have read.

feeds.title: Unconventional Quirky Bibliophile » LGBTQ+ Books
feeds.description: Posts about LGBTQ books written by unconventionalquirkybibliophile

feeds.title: Jill's Book Blog » LGBTQ
feeds.description: Hi there! I am a writer in Toronto, Ontario. I review six books a week and I also post blog memes daily! I have studied English, publishing, and creative writing. I also have my Master's in Creative and Critical Writing from the University of Gloucestershire. I am currently querying agents with my contemporary young adult novel about a Princess in England. I am writing a young adult fantasy novel! Read reviews and articles about LGBTQ books here!

feeds.title: Queer Sci Fi
feeds.description: Queer Sci Fi is a blog and website that's all about LGBT characters in science fiction, fantasy, paranormal and horror fiction. We're dedicated to promoting the inclusion of LGBT characters in these genres. We post regular discussion topics, news, book announcements and reviews.

feeds.title: Queeromance Ink
feeds.description: Welcome to QueeRomance Ink. We're an inclusive library of romance titles across the queer rainbow.

feeds.title: Scattered Thoughts and Rogue Words
feeds.description: Scattered Thoughts and Rogue Words is a dedicated LGBTQIA+ book review blog offering insightful critiques across all formats, including eBooks, audiobooks, and graphic novels.

feeds.title: I Heart SapphFic
feeds.description: Explore curated lists of must-read books, spanning various Sapphic subgenres, themes, and writing styles, ensuring that there's something for every reader to enjoy. Created and read by authors and individuals of the Sapphic community, I Heart SapphFic is a place for authors and fans of all types of sapphic fiction.

feeds.title: Annalise Reads » LGBTQ
feeds.description: Annalise Reads is a book blog dedicated to diverse literary voices, with a special emphasis on indie and marginalized authors. The LGBTQ category features thoughtful reviews of queer fiction across genres, including fantasy, romance, and children's literature.

feeds.title: Reads Rainbow
feeds.description: Reads Rainbow is a blog dedicated solely to LGBT media! Here you will find reviews, recs, and info about upcoming LGBT content, so that you can read/watch/listen till your heart's full of love!

feeds.title: LittleMissStar
feeds.description: The blog focuses mainly on LGBTQ+ books. I'm a 35 year old Australian book enthusiast. I am a lesbian, and my pronouns are she/they.

feeds.title: Local Bee Hunter's Nook Blog
feeds.description: The blog contains fiction, non-fiction and poetry themed books on LGBTQ or other diverse representation. E. is a sapphic blogger as she talks about books mostly those with LGBTQ+ characters or other representation.

feeds.title: AfterEllen » Books
feeds.description: Dive deeper into the complex tapestry of lesbian love stories. AfterEllen.com works the lesbian/bi pop culture beat with a fun, feminist perspective on film, television, music, books, and fashion. It also covers lifestyle issues like lesbian sex and dating, coming out, and our take on the current political climate as it affects our community.

feeds.title: Inkish Kingdoms » LGBT
feeds.description: This section of the blog features books on LGBTQ. Inkish Kingdoms is a small business that works with small and big authors to read and review books on multiple platforms.

feeds.title: Spectrum Books Blog
feeds.description: We're an independent publisher of fantastic LGBTQ fiction of all genres. Browse our catalog of wonderful novels, or submit your own to us today. At Spectrum Books it's our passion to share great works of LGBTQ+ fiction and non-fiction. We're a brand new publisher, built by dedicated best-selling authors.

feeds.title: Plucked from the Stacks
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Christopher Helton, a book reviewer, and a chatter. I'm just here to talk about books.

feeds.title: The Boy Who Cried Books
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Joseph J. Rey. I'm super queer and I have a profound love of stories. I'm a Chicano scholar, reader, writer and grad student. I review books and talk about book related things.

feeds.title: Queer Lit Blog
feeds.description: Find Book Reviews on many LGBT book titles and discover some of the hot topics around Queer Lit right now. Here at Queer Lit inclusion and diversity drive everything we do.We, like many members of the LGBTQ+ community, found it difficult to discover literature that best reflected our ethos and queer experiences.

feeds.title: A Lesbian and Her Laptop
feeds.description: 'A Lesbian and Her Laptop' is a WordPress blog that began in fall 2017. It holds a collection of thoughtful creative nonfiction pieces, fun list-posts, and content reviews with one running theme: The Queer Experience. As the blog continues to grow, I hope it serves as a hopeful place to all queer readers to feel understood, informed, and inspired.

feeds.title: Epic Reads Blog » LGBTQ
feeds.description: Check out all of our latest posts around LGBTQ+ on the Epic Reads Blog. Epic Reads is your video destination for all things YA and teen books. We post new Book Hauls once a month and more! You'll also find original digital episodes, interviews with YA authors, exclusive event access, and more cool stuff.

feeds.title: Takes Two to Book Review » LGBTQ Books
feeds.description: We're Anna and Alexis, twins who both studied English and creative writing in college. We've been reading and writing together as long as we can remember, and we're excited to share our bookish thoughts with you! Explore the latest LGBTQ books, reviews and more here.

feeds.title: Your Story Finder Blog
feeds.description: Resources and tips for LGBT nonfiction writers and allies from a book coach with more than 35 years of experience helping writers tell their stories. My mission is to amplify LGBTQ+ voices and bring more LGBTQ+ real-life stories into the world. To bring hope to the hopeless. Light to those in darkness. Empowerment to those who feel powerless. Connection to those who feel alone and 'othered.'

feeds.title: Lair of Books » Queer Books
feeds.description: Reading has always been a very personal experience for me & it wasn't until last year that I stumbled on to the book community on Booktube & Bookstagram. Needless to say, I felt like I found a long-lost relative and immediately began my love affair with all bookish platforms. On this blog I hope to connect with other book lovers, review a few of my reads, and just enjoy my love for all things books. Explore the books in the queer genre, recommendations, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Independent Book Review » LGBTQ Fiction
feeds.description: Independent Book Review wants you to read indie. In April 2018, we started IBR to encourage more readers to find their way to indie books. Explore the unexplored and unknown books in LGBTQ fiction genre, reviews and more!

feeds.title: ReQueered Tales Blog
feeds.description: The mission of ReQueered Tales: to bring back to circulation a treasure trove of fantastic LGBTQ fiction. In an era of e-books, everything of value ought to be accessible. And many in affordable trade paperbacks as well. For a new generation of readers.

feeds.title: Clare Lydon Blog
feeds.description: Clare Lydon is a lesbian fiction author and lover of Curly Wurlys. Her books have been described as 'romantic, addictive, fabulous!' and she couldn't have put it better herself. Check out her stories, new books, news and more!

feeds.title: Never Judge a Book by its Cover » LGBTQ
feeds.description: Never Judge a Book by it Cover was created back in 2012. It's a UK-based review site, focusing on young and new adult titles. (possibly the odd adult book as well.) These have been reviewed by myself, Emma, and are an honest review and reflection of the novel sent by the publishers. Explore all the books and their reviews, new books, book recommendations and more!

feeds.title: American Library Association's Rainbow Round Table
feeds.description: Explore Book and media reviews from the American Library Association's Rainbow Round Table. Rainbow RT Reviews is the official source of media reviews for the Rainbow Round Table of the American Library Association (ALA). Reviews are written by Rainbow RT members and cover GLBT-themed materials for children, young adults, and adults.

feeds.title: BeffyNicole Reads Blog
feeds.description: Explore recommendations & reviews by a queer book blogger. My name is Bethany, but I also go by Kiwi. I used to mainly read fantasy until I realized I absolutely love queer contemporary romance. I want to share all the fantastic queer books I've read!

feeds.title: Books Bird » LGBT Books
feeds.description: Books Bird is a website run by journalist and avid reader, Catherine Muxworthy. An ideal blog for book lovers as it covers all things relating to books and literature from news and reviews to longer features. Explore books under the LGBT genre, reviews, opinions and more!

feeds.title: The Chrysalis Brew Project » LGBTQ
feeds.description: Browse through book recommendations and other bookish posts in the LGBTQ genre. The Chrysalis BREW Project is an Australia-based award-winning platform catering to all content creators and readers worldwide! This is where you'd find thoughts, words, photos, videos, and other ideas in the realm of Books, Reviews, and Everything Written (BREW).

feeds.title: B&N Reads Blog » Pride
feeds.description: Barnes & Noble, Inc. is the largest retail bookseller in the United States, and a leading retailer of content, digital media and educational products. Check out our pride collection, authors' information, reviews and more!

feeds.title: Lambda Literary
feeds.description: The blog covers LGBT book reviews, author interviews, opinions, news, and much more. Lambda Literary nurtures and advocates for LGBTQ writers, elevating the impact of their words to a creative community, preserve legacies and affirm the value of our stories and our lives.

feeds.title: Bisexual Books
feeds.description: Here you'll find views and reviews on books from multiple genres and for all ages from the bisexual perspective. Because literature is an integral part of community, andBecause it is incredibly important for bisexual people to see bisexuals represented in the media around them, and yetBecause books about bisexuals are underrepresented in mainstream as well as queer review sources, Bisexual Books reads, reviews, and talks about bisexual authors, stories, and characters.

feeds.title: WLW Library
feeds.description: Browse through WLW Library for LGBTQ books, reviews, opinions, and more. Craving a good dose of romance between dazzling heroines? This Tumblr blog is your one-stop shop for all things sapphic book reviews, where we celebrate love stories that defy the norm and make our hearts soar.
